acceptance: rejects partially overlapped rectangle in contain mode and selects it in overlap mode: given A rectangle at (0, 0, 100, 100) and a lasso path that clips only its top-left corner, expect Selected elements are empty in "contain" mode and [rect.id] in "overlap" mode, and a fully enclosing lasso selects [rect.id] in "contain" mode

selects rounded rectangle when lasso encloses its rounded outline even if cutting sharp AABB corners: given A rounded rectangle (roundness: ADAPTIVE_RADIUS) and a lasso polygon passing inside the sharp AABB corners but outside the rounded corner arcs, expect The rounded rectangle is selected in "contain" mode

evaluates full outline containment for diamond and ellipse in contain mode: given A diamond and an ellipse tested with a partial lasso vs a lasso that encloses the shape outline while cutting through empty AABB corners, expect Partial lasso leaves each unselected in "contain" and selected in "overlap"; outline-enclosing lasso selects each in "contain"

evaluates full outline containment for rotated shapes in contain mode: given A rotated rectangle (angle: Math.PI / 4) tested with a lasso clipping one rotated corner vs a lasso enclosing all four rotated corners, expect Corner-clipping lasso leaves the rotated rectangle unselected in "contain" and selected in "overlap"; full rotated-outline lasso selects it in "contain"

evaluates full outline containment for lines, arrows, and freedraw strokes in contain mode: given A line, an arrow, and a freedraw element tested with a lasso enclosing only part of the stroke vs the entire stroke, expect Partial lasso leaves each unselected in "contain" and selected in "overlap"; full lasso selects each in "contain"

requires bound text and arrow labels to be enclosed with their container or arrow in contain mode: given A rectangle with bound text (lasso enclosing only the bound text vs both) and an arrow with a bound text label (lasso enclosing only the arrow shaft vs both arrow and label), expect Enclosing only bound text or only the arrow shaft leaves the element unselected in "contain" and selected in "overlap"; enclosing both selects the container/arrow in "contain"

selects a group in contain mode only when all selectable group members are enclosed: given Two grouped rectangles (with bound text on one member) tested with a lasso enclosing one member vs all members, expect Enclosing one member selects nothing in "contain" and the whole group in "overlap"; enclosing all selectable members selects the group and sets selectedGroupIds in "contain"

clips a frame child to its containing frame in contain mode while keeping overlap mode unclipped: given A frame at (0, 0, 100, 100) and a child rectangle at (50, 20, 100, 60) with frameId: frame.id extending to x = 150 past the frame's right edge, expect A lasso enclosing the visible portion inside the frame (x: 40..105, y: 10..90, crossing the frame's right edge at x = 100) selects the child and not the frame in "contain" mode, and selects the frame and not the child in "overlap" mode; a lasso enclosing only the hidden portion outside the frame (x: 110..160, y: 10..90) leaves the child unselected in "contain" mode and selects the child in "overlap" mode
